title: AI-accelerator equities re-rate lower on the next in-line ASIC print by Q4 2026
body: The AI-accelerator and custom-ASIC equity complex now reacts to in-line guidance the way it once reacted to a miss, and that asymmetry is the prediction's engine. Broadcom's fiscal-Q2 report beat on revenue and EPS but guided Q3 AI-semiconductor revenue to roughly $16 billion against a roughly $17.2 billion consensus and pointedly declined to raise its full-year 2026 AI forecast; the stock fell about 15% and pulled the rest of the group down for two straight sessions (Micron, Intel, AMD, and Nvidia all lower), with a deepening memory-pricing crisis compounding the move. The structural read is that these names are priced for continuous beat-and-raise, so a merely-solid quarter is repriced as a disappointment and the correlation drags peers with it. The forecast: the next major custom-ASIC or merchant-accelerator print that meets-not-raises - the subsequent Broadcom, Marvell, AMD, or Nvidia data-center update - triggers a repeat of this pattern by Q4 2026, namely a double-digit single-session drop in the reporting name accompanied by a correlated sell-off across the accelerator and high-bandwidth-memory peers, alongside visible sell-side estimate cuts or a coverage re-rating that trims AI-chip revenue and target assumptions for the group. What breaks the thesis is a clean beat-and-raise from the next reporter that re-anchors expectations upward, or a print that misses outright (which would make any drawdown a fundamentals story rather than the expectations-asymmetry story this prediction is about); what confirms it is an in-line guide that still clears the prior quarter yet sells off on the gap to a raised bar.

reasoning.because: Broadcom beat but guided Q3 AI-semi ~$16B vs ~$17.2B and held FY26; AVGO -15%, the group fell 2 days
reasoning.given: AI-hardware equities are priced for continuous beat-and-raise, so in-line guidance reads as a miss
reasoning.so_that: The next in-line custom-ASIC/accelerator print triggers another correlated group drawdown and AI-chip estimate cuts
reasoning.landing: by Q4 2026; in-line print -> -10% single name + correlated peer drop
reasoning.plain_language: AI chip stocks now need to keep beating expectations, so the next merely-okay earnings report should drag the whole group down again.

summary: Broadcom beat but guided Q3 AI-semi below consensus and held its FY26 AI forecast; AVGO fell ~15%, dragging the accelerator/memory complex lower. Priced for continuous beat-and-raise, the group should take another correlated drawdown and estimate cuts on the next in-line print by Q4 2026.
